propositions: A concurrent commit between verify and sign steps causes the ticket to close WITHOUT a completion signature attestation, leaving it in a permanently closed unsigned state.
The verify and sign operations independently read HEAD, allowing an unrelated commit from another agent to split them and invalidate the attestation without preventing the close.
The suggested recovery of re-closing an already-closed ticket is a no-op, leaving only --force-close or manual manifest fabrication as unacceptable workarounds.
The default code path (no --ref argument) still reads HEAD twice and remains vulnerable; the --ref path pinned by 80af is coherent but not the default.
The close should either pin one revision for the entire verify+sign+close unit (signing the verified commit despite later HEAD movement) or abort and leave the ticket in_progress for retry.
